scale_cues: White square dinner plate assumed to be about 25 cm across; fruit pieces judged at roughly 2-3 cm each relative to the plate width, and counted per type.
assumptions: Plate is a standard ~25 cm square dinner plate
Fruit is fresh and raw with no added sugar, syrup or dressing
Yellow pieces are pineapple (fibrous texture), not mango or cantaloupe
Pieces are about 2 cm thick, as depth cannot be seen from overhead
Pineapple at 50 kcal/100 g and watermelon at 30 kcal/100 g
